items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So Roy Melton, when I told him about it, he went and put the little sparklers in... Hobart Banks on piano, Roy Melton was the singer and Spurgeon West alto and Eddie Nicholson was drums.

ctx.x: And he became your very best friend?
Yes, very best. That's what junior was saying, Rene Hall and Roy Melton, anytime you say anything to anybody to them, they would say something about that they worked with Ernie Fields.
I worked extensively with Roy and your name was always mentioned.
